      @OmitSymbol(unless="zemeckis.enable_names") public String getName()
      Return the name of the VirtualProcessorUnit. This method should NOT be invoked unless Zemeckis.areNamesEnabled() returns true and will throw an exception if invariant checking is enabled.
      Returns:
      the name of the VirtualProcessorUnit.

    • queue

      public Cancelable queue(@Nullable String name, Runnable task)
      Queue task for execution and enable the executor for activation if necessary. The task must not be already queued.
      Parameters:
      name - A human consumable name for the task. It should be non-null if Zemeckis.areNamesEnabled() returns true and null otherwise.
      task - the task.
      Returns:
      the Cancelable instance that can be used to cancel execution of the task.
